tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: List all active airport-transfer routes with their slug, endpoints, distance, travel time, available directions, and starting price.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get fixed per-vehicle prices for a route, or for all routes if no routeSlug is given. Prices are fixed (no surge, no metered fares), in EUR and RSD. Each vehicle tier lists max passengers and luggage.

routeSlug.description: Optional route slug (e.g. 'novi-sad-belgrade-airport'). Omit to get pricing for every route.

tools.name: estimate_price
tools.description: Estimate the price for a trip. Given a route and passenger count (and optional luggage count), returns the cheapest vehicle that fits the group, plus all fitting options.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Get business info: service area, accepted payment methods, supported languages, minimum booking lead time, contact details, and how to book (including the booking URL template).

tools.name: create_booking_request
tools.description: Start a provisional airport-transfer booking. This does NOT finalize a booking — it emails the passenger a one-tap confirmation link, and the ride is only booked once they click it. Payment is to the driver (cash or card); no online payment is needed. The result says where the confirmation link was sent and until when it is valid.

direction.description: to_airport = going to the airport; from_airport = pickup at the airport.

pickupDate.description: Pickup date, YYYY-MM-DD, Belgrade local time.

pickupTime.description: Pickup time, HH:MM (24h), Belgrade local time.

passengerEmail.description: Passenger email — the confirmation link is sent here.

passengerPhone.description: Passenger phone in international E.164 format, starting with + and the country code (e.g. +381641234567, +491512345678). Without the +country code the driver cannot message the passenger on WhatsApp or Viber.

vehicle.description: Optional vehicle tier name (e.g. 'Group XL'). Defaults to the cheapest vehicle that fits the group.

pickupAddress.description: Pickup or drop-off address. REQUIRED when the ride departs to the airport (direction to_airport) or runs city-to-city — the driver has nowhere to collect the passenger otherwise, and the booking is refused. Optional for an airport arrival, where the driver waits in arrivals.

locale.description: Language for the confirmation email. Default en.

tools.name: get_booking_request_status
tools.description: Check whether a booking request has been confirmed by the passenger yet. Returns 'pending', 'confirmed' (with the booking number), or 'expired'.

requestId.description: The requestId of a booking request.
